# Pickering Heating & Cooling

> Pickering Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Pickering, Durham Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (905) 831-4059  |  Email: contact@pickeringheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://pickeringheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope
